Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase.
...THE RUN CHASE...

Right then, South Africa need just 121 runs to do a clean sweep and they will be feeling confident. Sri Lanka on the other hand, will be looking to their bowlers to get something out of this match. They have proved in the recent past that they can defend modest totals but will they be able do it today? Find out soon as the chase is coming up.

It is like getting beaten at your own game again for Sri Lanka. None of their batters just look to give themselves time out there in the middle. Apart from Kusal Perera, who is a stroke player and the skipper, Dasun Shanaka, only Chamika Karunaratne is one who trusts his own ability and always puts up a fight in the end. The Sri Lankan batters, specially the middle-order need to pull themselves together ahead of the qualifiers for the T20 World Cup or it could be even more misery for the hosts.

For South Africa, it all started with Rabada's early wickets in the Powerplay and then the spinners came on and chipped in with wickets at regular intervals. All the bowlers executed their plans brilliantly on this low and slow wicket and made things difficult for Sri Lanka. 14 overs in total were bowled by the spinners and they kept things very tight in the middle. Sri Lankan batters found it vey hard to get going and they could only manage 120.

This has been an exceptional display of bowling from the visitors and they would have definitely taken this score at the start of the innings. The hosts couldn't get rid of their own demons and will now have to bowl exceptionally well.
SIX! What a way to finish off the innings! Dragged-down delivery, on middle. Chamika Karunaratne hangs back and muscles it way over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie. SRI LANKA END WITH 120/8.
Shamsi sees that Karunaratne is shuffling across and hence, pushes it wide and very full. Chamika Karunaratne gets it to long off and they race back for the second.
And again, Karunaratne shuffles across and Shamsi fires in another wrong 'un, wide outside off. Chamika Karunaratne is yet again beaten.
The wrong 'un this time. On off and Chamika Karunaratne looks to slog, but he misses as the ball spins away.
Dragged down on off. Chamika Karunaratne pulls it down to long on but doesn't take the run. He wants to take on Tabraiz Shamsi all by himself and understandbly so.
Chammera steps out and Shamsi pushes it wider. Chameera manages to toe-end it towards wide long off for a single.
This time Karunaratne tries to hoick this ball over mid-wicket but the ball was way outside off and Karunaratne doesn't time it and in the end just manages to get a single to mid-wicket.
Back of a length, slower and outside off. Karunaratne dabs it down on the off side for a single.

SIX! NAILED! That is definitely the shot of the day. Full and wide, Chamika Karunaratne gets low and plays an inside-out shot. He creams it over the extra cover fence for a biggie. Much-needed boundary for the hosts.
Full and wide outside off, Karunaratne comes down the track and looks to play it through covers but gets an inside edge down to short fine leg, where the fielder fumbles and they get a couple.
Who will walk out to bat?

OUT! CAUGHT! Dasun Shanaka just had to take on the bowling now and unfortunately for him, he has to depart. Slower delivery, on a good length and Shanka advances down the track and looks to clear long on. He doesn't quite get to the pitch of the ball and miscues it towards long on. Rassie van der Dussen settles under it and takes a fine catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Rassie van der Dussen b Wiaan Mulder

Commentary.Commentary: On a length, wide outside off, Karunaratne slaps it to long off for a single
Wiaan Mulder comes into the attack.
Looped up, on middle and turning back in. Dasun Shanaka advances down the track looking to slog it away. He gets beaten by the flight and turn and misses. The ball hits him on the pads.

FOUR! That's cheeky but effective. It takes a lot of confidence to play the reverse sweep when your team is in a stiff situation. Low full toss, on off and Shanaka reverse-sweeps it past backward point for a boundary.
Flighted ball, around off, nudged to the off side for one.
Shamsi sees Dasun Shanaka coming down the pitch and bowls it short and wide. Shanaka manages to dab it down to short third man for a quick single.
Tossed up, on middle. Shanaka looks to paddle it fine but can't beat the fielder at short fine leg.
Shorter ball, on middle and turning down the leg side. Chamika Karunaratne turns it behind square for a single.
Change.
Flatter one, around off. Shanaka hits it straight to point.
Looped up, on middle. Shanaka keeps it out.
BEATEN! Maharaj pushes this one quicker on off and the ball holds its line. Shanaka looks to block but gets beaten comprehensively.
On off and nudged to cover-point for a quick single. Good running.
A tad fuller, on middle. Chamika Karunaratne works it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Outside off and cut away to sweeper cover for one.
Sliding down leg and Shanaka looks to flick. He misses and the ball goes off the pads to short fine leg. They get a leg bye.
Angled in on leg and straightens after pitching. Shanaka watchfully keeps it out.
Fullish ball, on off. Chamika Karunaratne pushes it to long on for a run.
On a length and sliding on at middle. Chamika Karunaratne hops back to defend but gets hit on the pads. Just a slight appeal from the bowler.
A touch shorter and outside off. Dasun Shanaka cuts it to deep point for a run.
Sliding in on middle and leg, tucked to square leg.
Flatter one, around off, tapped to the cover region.
On off stump and pushed back to the bowler.
Tossed up, around off and pushed to cover. Once again there's a bit of hesitation and Karunaratne is sent back. He is safe though.
Nicely flighted, on middle. Chamika Karunaratne gets behind the line well to defend it out.
Who will come in now?

OUT! RUN OUT! Oh dear, Sri Lanka are making a mess of it. Maharaj serves a quicker ball, on off. Lahiru Madushanka taps it towards point and looks to take a run. Dasun Shanaka is not at all interested for a run and sends him back. Rassie van der Dussen at cover-point gets to the ball quickly and throws it to Quinton de Kock who collects it and whips the bails off. Lahiru Madushanka is halfway down the pitch and has nowhere to go. Another one departs.
Commentary.Howout: run out (Rassie van der Dussen / Quinton de Kock)

Commentary.Commentary: Flatter ball, on off. Lahiru Madushanka defends it out.
Flatter ball, down leg. Lahiru Madushanka tucks it towards fine leg and collects a single.
Who will come in at number 8?

OUT! TAKEN! Sri Lanka are in all sorts of trouble and South Africa are well and truly on top! Tossed up, on off. Wanindu Hasaranga steps out and looks to drive but hits it straight to Keshav Maharaj at extra cover who takes an easy catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Keshav Maharaj b Bjorn Fortuin

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up, on middle. Wanindu Hasaranga steps down and goes inside out uppishly towards sweeper cover. They take two.
A touch shorter and outside off. Hasaranga punches it off the back foot through covers for a couple of runs.
SAFE! On middle and Wanindu Hasaranga looks to block. He gets an inside edge onto the pads and the ball loops up around short leg. Quinton de Kock is a bit late and the ball falls safe.
Around off and nudged towards cover-point for a quick single.
Wanindu Hasaranga is the new man in.

OUT! LBW! Kusal Perera's struggle comes to an end. South Africa's skipper strikes this time. Maharaj serves a length ball, on middle and leg. Kusal Perera misses the flick and gets rapped on the pads. Keshav Maharaj appeals and the umpire raises his finger. Kusal Perera decides to review but the Ball Tracker shows three reds and Perera has to walk back to the pavilion.
Kusal Perera has taken the review.
Tossed up, on leg. Kusal Perera gets low and sweeps it towards deep square leg for a couple.
Quicker ball, on leg. Dasun Shanaka stays back to work it down the ground and collects a single.
Flatter ball, on middle. Kusal Perera tucks it on the leg side for a run.
Tossed up, on off. Dasun Shanaka defends it to backward point and scampers through for a run. The fielder has a shy at the non-striker's end but Dasun Shanaka was well inside the crease.
Flatter ball, on off. Kusal Perera works it on the leg side for a single.
FOUR! In the air...but just wide of the diving wicket-keeper. Good-length ball, on off. Dasun Shanaka cuts it late and the ball goes past Quinton de Kock who dives to his right.
Back of a length, just outside off. Kusal Perera guides it towards Tabraiz Shamsi at short third man.
Good-length ball, darted on the pads. Shanaka turns it towards fine leg and takes an easy run.
Short of a length, on off. Kusal Perera makes room and punches it hard towards long off for a run.
Slower ball, on a length, around off. Kusal Perera drags it back to the bowler off the inner half of the bat.
Good-length ball, on middle. Dasun Shanaka whips it off his pads towards fine leg for one.
Bowling change.
Quicker ball, on off. Dasun Shanaka works it down the ground and collects a run.
Lovely delivery! Tossed up, on off, turning away late. Dasun Shanaka looks to defend but the ball zips past his outside edge.
Flatter ball, going with the angle. Kusal Perera hangs back and works it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Tossed up, on middle and leg. Dasun Shanaka flicks it towards deep mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
Floated on off. Dasun Shanaka blocks it out.
Short ball, on off. Kusal Perera stays back and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Keshav Maharaj comes into bowl now.
On off and pushed back to the bowler.
A touch short and wide, Dasun Shanaka looks to cut off the back foot but misses.
Flatter one, on middle. Shanaka pushes it to mid on.
Who will walk out to bat now?

OUT! CAUGHT! Aiden Markram continues his superb form with the ball. Markram flights this one up on middle stump and bowls it a bit slower, the ball turns and Kamindu Mendis doesn't pick it up. Mendis looks to turn it on the on side and the ball pops up off the leading edge of the bat while closing the face. It goes straight to extra cover where Keshav Maharaj takes a simple catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Keshav Maharaj b Aiden Markram

Commentary.Commentary: Angled in on middle and leg, Mendis makes room and plays it to cover.
Sliding into leg stump. Perera works it off the back foot to deep mid-wicket for one.
This one turned. Outside off and this time the ball gripped the surface, beating the outside edge of a poking Kamindu Mendis.
Low full toss, sliding down leg. Perera presents a straight face of the willow and gets it to deep mid-wicket. They get one.
Loopy ball, on middle. Perera drives it to wide long on and collects a couple of runs.
Fuller ball, on middle and Mendis sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
Tossed up, on middle. Kusal Perera looks to sweep but mistimes it to short fine leg. They do get a quick single. Good running.
Sliding in on middle and leg, Mendis works it with soft hands towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
On middle and defended out by Kusal Perera.
Flighted ball, outside off and Kamindu Mendis goes after it. He plays an inside-out cover drive that fetches him a single.
Flatter ball, angled in on middle. Kusal Perera works it to deep mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
Fuller ball, on off. Kept out by Perera.
Tossed up, on middle. Mendis drives it down to long off for a run.
On off and played towards point.
Change.
Slightly shorter and on leg, Mendis flicks it off the back foot to deep square leg for one.
On the pads and Perera works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter delivery, punched off the back foot on the off side for another one.
Tossed up, on off. Mendis looks to drive but gets a leading edge which falls short of the point fielder.
Short ball, on off. Kusal Perera rocks back and pulls it to wide long on for a run.
A touch short and wide, Mendis cuts it to deep backward point for a run.
Tabraiz Shamsi is into the attack now.
Change.
Full and straight, crunched to mid on. Sri Lanka are 47/3 at the end of the Powerplay.
FOUR! Classy shot from Kusal Perera. Back of a length, on off and just a punch off the back foot. This one goes past mid off and races into the fence.
The off-spinner from Rabada, on middle and going away. Mendis nudges it down to third man for a single.
Length ball, on middle. Mendis plays a lofted straight drive and holds the pose. The ball clears mid on and Keshav Maharaj chases it down in time, keeping it to a couple.
Good-length ball, on middle. Mendis keeps it out.
On the pads and tucked away to deep square leg for a run.
Length again, around off. Mendis taps it to cover.
Length ball, on off. Kusal Perera drives it towards cover and gets a single.
Short and wide, cut away behind square on the off side for a couple.
Back of a length, on off. Kusal Perera stays back and defends it off the back foot to cover.

Four! Misfield again!!! This time, it is a short ball on the stumps. Perera pulls it powerfully straight to the deep square leg fielder who misjudges it completely and the ball ends up racing to the boundary. This is poor fielding by SA. There are letting Sri Lanka off the hook here. Nevertheless, very important runs for Sri Lanka and Perera.

FOUR! Sloppy work from Keshav Maharaj. Full ball, on off. Kusal Perera flicks it off his pads wide of mid on. Maharaj gets across to his left, bends low but it is a lazy effort and the ball escapes through. Maharaj gets up and puts in a chase but cannot get to the ball. Pretorius is not too happy.
Who will come in now?

OUT! TIMBER! Kagiso Rabada IS ON FIRE! A yorker, around middle. Bhanuka Rajapaksa makes room to drive but he fails to get any bat on it and the ball crashes onto his stumps. Another one bites the dust!
FOUR! STREAKY! Full ball, outside off. Bhanuka Rajapaksa looks to drive but only gets a thick outside edge and the ball flies over the short third man fielder for a boundary.

What a BOUNCER!!!! Perera makes room for himself but Rabada is equal to the task and bowls a perfect bouncer following Perera's body. He just manages to move away his head at the last moment as that ball goes through to the keeper.
This time he makes room to this full ball on off stump and smashes that ball straight to mid off fielder.
On the pads this time on length, clipped away to mid-wicket.
Short delivery around off, Perera cuts it off the back foot to deep third man for a couple.
There is a halt in play.
Flighted ball, outside off. Bhanuka Rajapaksa looks to sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Flatter ball, on off. Kusal Perera stays back adn works it down the ground for a single.
Loopy ball, down leg. Bhanuka Rajapaksa turns it behind square on the leg side and collects a run.
Tossed up, on middle. Bhanuka Rajapaksa blocks it out.
Who will come in at number 4?

OUT! STUMPED! Dhananjaya de Silva's poor run of form continues! Fortuin serves a quicker ball, around leg. Dhananjaya de Silva steps down to slog but he misses and the ball goes to Quinton de Kock behind the sticks who collects the ball cleanly and whips the bails off. The same woes continue for Sri Lanka.
Commentary.Howout: st Quinton de Kock b Bjorn Fortuin

Commentary.Commentary: Flatter ball, on middle. Dhananjaya de Silva works it towards mid-wicket.
Back of a length, on off. Dhananjaya de Silva works it towards third man to get off the mark with a single.
Who will come in next?

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! A wicket against the run of play here! Kagiso Rabada strikes for South Africa. A full ball, around off. Avishka Fernando looks to dig it out but he squeezes it straight back to Kagiso Rabada who pouches it. Rabada has a polite enquiry with the umpire who sends the decision upstairs. The replays suggest that the it was not a bump ball and Avishka Fernando has to depart.
The umpires have gone upstairs. Kagiso Rabada thinks the ball has come directly off the bat and not the surface. The replay shows that he is right and the decision on the big screen is OUT.
Short of a length, on middle. Avishka Fernando pulls it towards deep square leg for a couple.
FOUR! SHOT! Good-length ball, around leg. Avishka Fernando makes room on the off side and sends this one over the mid on fielder. The ball races away for a boundary.
Good-length ball, on leg. Avishka Fernando hangs back and turns it uppishly towards mid-wicket.
Rabada bangs in short, on middle and leg. Kusal Perera stays back and pulls it towards fine leg for a run.
Who will bowl from the other end?
Quicker ball, darted on the pads. Avishka Fernando tickles it towards short fine leg.
FOUR! Nicely done! Floated around middle. Avishka Fernando gets down and sweeps it over the short fine leg fielder for a boundary.
Well bowled! Flatter ball, on off. Avishka Fernando taps it towards backward point.

In the air...but safe! Tossed up, on off. Avishka Fernando gets low and looks to sweep but gets a top edge which falls just in front of the short fine leg fielder who was running behind. They take two.
Flatter ball, on middle and leg. Kusal Perera works it towards square leg for a run.
2 Wides! Another one sprayed down leg. Quinton de Kock fails to collect the ball cleanly and they take one. Wided!
Wide! Flatter ball, sprayed down leg. Avishka Fernando leaves it alone. Wided!
Tossed up, on off. Kusal Perera turns it towards deep mid-wicket. Sri Lanka and Perera are up and running!
We are ready for play.
Dasun Shanaka, the skipper of Sri Lanka says that they will bat first. Adds that their batting order did not click in the firat two games so they have made two changes in the middle-order.

Keshav Maharaj says that they have made one change, Wiaan Mulder comes in and they are trying new combinations before the World Cup. He adds that they want to be as clinical as possible and would want to win it 3-nil. He also adds that we have an extra all-rounder today and it's important to get everyone ready for different conditions

PITCH REPORT - Aamer Sohail, the birthday boy says, that the curators have prepared another hard and dry pitch. The spinners will enjoy bowling and the fast bowlers will look to chop and change their pace. The pitch has a bit of grass cover.

Sri Lanka (Playing XI) - Kusal Perera (WK), Avishka Fernando (In for Dinesh Chandimal), Bhanuka Rajapaksa, Dhananjaya de Silva, Kamindu Mendis (In for Charith Asalanka), Dasun Shanaka (C), Wanindu Hasaranga, Chamika Karunaratne, Dushmantha Chameera, Lahiru Madushanka (In for Praveen Jayawickrama), Maheesh Theekshana.

South Africa (Playing XI) - Quinton de Kock (WK), Reeza Hendricks, Aiden Markram, Rassie van der Dussen, Heinrich Klaasen, Dwaine Pretorius, Wiaan Mulder (In for Anrich Nortje), Kagiso Rabada, Keshav Maharaj (C), Bjorn Fortuin, Tabraiz Shamsi.
Sri Lankan stalwart Lasith Malinga has announced his retirement from T20s and has now officially retired from all forms of the game.
TOSS - Up goes the coin and in lands in Sri Lanka's favor. They have elected to bat first.

Sri Lanka have had a torrid year with Covid and players getting banned for breach of protocols but their main problem has been their batting which hasn't clicked at all. The spinners have been great and the pacers have done well in conditions that don't necessarily suit them. South Africa, on the other hand have been in top form in T20Is and maybe for the first time, they aren't one of the favorites to win the T20 World Cup. But judging by the way they have adapted to life without their superstars, they might just be the dark horses of the tournament, but all this is for the future. Right now, Sri Lanka need a win desperately to get some confidence going but will they?

Hello and welcome to the third and final T20I between Sri Lanka and South Africa. South Africa have already wrapped up the series with a dominating win in the second match. They will now look to complete a whitewash which will give them a serious boost ahead of the T20 World Cup. Sri Lanka will look to get rid of their familiar batting collapses and sign off with a win here and get some momentum going as they have to play qualifiers to get into the main draw at the T20 World Cup. A lot to play for. Toss and team news in a bit.
